title: Open Corpus: Reboot Democracy and InnovateUS
intro: An open, machine-readable index of content from Reboot Democracy (rebootdemocracy.ai) and InnovateUS (innovate-us.org): blog posts, weekly news digests, workshops, workshop recordings and courses. Every entry links to the original page.
about: This catalog is generated from the search index behind rebootdemocracy.ai and innovate-us.org, and every link is checked before it is listed (`scripts/export-urls.mjs`, `scripts/check-links.mjs`, then `scripts/build-readme.mjs`). It holds links, short teasers taken from the pages themselves, and metadata; please cite the linked pages. Spotted an error? Open an issue.
